book.name: 1 KORINITA
book.title: Paulo La Ginigini Yamatala BaisaMINA KORINITA

content: Gala ibodi totapwaroru bitotusi okaboyakala

Kidamwa availa yokomi bikominimani deli sola matauna totapwaroru, gala ibodi bilau matauna e kasitaiyu bitotusi omatala toyakala, kidamwa matauna toyakala gala totapwaroru. Kaimapula, ibodi Yaubada la tomota binagaisi paila si kominimani.
Ki, bogwa kunikolaisi kidamwa Yaubada la tomota biyakalaisi komwaidosi mina watanawa. E kidamwa yokomi bukuyakalaisi valu watanawa bogwa bibodaimi bukutoyakalasi paila vavagi kwekikekita.
Kaina gala kunikolaisi kidamwa yakidasi bitayakalaisi anelosi? E kidamwa makawala, bibodaidasi sainela bitatoyakalasi paila uvagila valu watanawa.
Kidamwa goli kominimani bitokaia oluwalaimi, ki, kudokaisi ibodi bukutugwalaisi semia bitotusi omatala toyakala matauna gala toekalesia, kidamwa binagi avaka kasi pakula?
Kami mmosila mokwita! Ki, kaina taitala toninitalapula oluwalela ekalesia isisu, gagabila bitoyakala paila semia, ke?

Mitaga avaka lokuvagaisi? Ka, avai tuta kominimani itokaia, taitala taitala bilau sola e kasitaiyu biyakalasi omitasi avai toyakala gala totapwaroru matauna, e itagwalasi kidamwa matauna gala todubumi binagi availa yokomi tosula.

Bogwa kominimani eitokaia oluwalaimi e mapaila lokuyakalasi makawala ke? Baisa iyomitali paila lokumamasi wala tuta komwaidona. Ki, kaina bibodaimi bukutugwalaimi bukubodasi mwau tutala availa biyogagaimi? Kaina bibodaimi bukutugwalaimi bilebwaimi wala.
Kaimapula wala, yokomi titoulemi kusulasi taitala baisa taitala, deli kulubulebusi taitala baisa taitala, kalubikoya kaina budamia goli.
Yokomi kunikolaisi mokwita kidamwa tomitugaga gala bikauwaisi Karaiwogala Yaubada.
Gala bukusipulokaimi titoulemi. Matausina si bubunela gegedu, kaina ititapwarorusi baisa tokolu, kaina tokwakailasi, kaina matausina si bubunela kala gegedu tau bimisii tau,
kaina tolibulebu, kaina togugoveka, kaina tomomom sopi kaipeula, kaina tosilapulu, kaina tokowolova karaiwaga - gala taitala matausina bikau Karaiwogala Yaubada.

Omitibogwa mimilimi yokomi makawala wala matausina. Mitaga Yaubada leikatumigileuwaimi metoya omi mitugaga e ikabomaimi baisa titoulela. E Yaubada leikabwailimi uula lokudubumaisi Guyau Yesu Keriso metoya ola pilasi Bilomala da Yaubadasi.
Kala yakaula Yaubada metoya wa woula

Ka, kaina taitala bilivala, kawala, “Ibodaigu bavagi avaka magigu wala.” E yeigu bamapu, kawagu, “E mokwita. Mitaga kaina mimilisi vavagi gala ibudokaim.” Gagabila yeigu balivala, “Ibodaigu bavagi avaka magigu wala.” Mitaga gala batagwala avai vavagi bikatupipaigu.

E kaina taiyuwela bilivala, kawala, “Ka, kaula paila lula, e lulaga paila kaula.” E, mokwita. Mitaga Yaubada ikaibiga, kawala, “Lula deli kaula biwokuva wala.” Tomota uwosi gala isisu kidamwa bivagaisi ulatila uvagila, mitaga kidamwa bivagaisi uvagila Guyau. E Guyau isisu kidamwa bipilasi tomota uwosi.
E ka, Yaubada itokowoi Guyau imovavau, e yakidasi deli bitatokaiasi bitamovavausi metoya ola peula.
Mapaila yokomi bogwa kunikolaisi uwomi baisa katupwaila wowola Keriso. Ki, ibodaigu bakau katupwaila wowola Keriso, e bavigaki katupwaila wowola minana nakalimwala? Baisa goli gala gagabila.

Kaina gala kunikolaisi kidamwa availa bogwa isepituki wowola deli minana nakalimwala, bogwa kasitaiyu leivigaki uwosi makawala taitala tomota. Paila Buki Pilabumaboma kala ginigini isisu kala mimilakatila, “Kasitaiyu bivigaki uwosi makawala taitala tomota.”
Mitaga availa ivasosu deli Guyau, kasitaiyu bivigaki bilomasi makawala taitala wala tomota.

Kuligaiwaisi bubunela gegedu. Kidamwa availa ivagi avai mitugaga ituwoli, gala wala biyogagi wowola titoulela. Mitaga kidamwa taitala tau bivagi mitugaga makwaina bubunela saina gegedu baisa iyogagi wowola titoulela.

E yokomi kaina gala kunikolaisi uwomi baisa Baloma Tobumaboma la Bwala Kwebumaboma. E matauna eisivagasi oluwalaimi, paila Yaubada bogwa isaiki matauna baisa yokomi. E yokomi gala mi vavagi titoulemi wala. Mitaga yokomi Yaubada la vavagi.
Paila matauna eisaili mapu e igimolaimi. Mapaila ibodi bukuyakawolaisi Yaubada metoya ouwomi.
